stance_target: a specific security-relevant regression introduced (and caught/fixed) during the discovery-plugin refactor, relevant to anyone deploying a custom or file-discovery EPP and assuming metrics/pprof endpoints are gated the same way as in Kubernetes mode
scope_conditions: llm-d/llm-d-router PR #1007 review thread, fixed before merge on May 25, 2026, commit d40587ac500e922feb06cdf459427ed40cb57e16
quoted_support: pprof and /metrics are served unauthenticated. This is a regression from old path... With EnablePprof=true heap/goroutine profiles are exposed unauthenticated... runner: honor MetricsEndpointAuth in serveMetrics, fix shutdown timeout. Fixed in d40587a

scope_conditions: llm-d/llm-d-router PR #1007, fixed before merge, commit 0e3388ea3bfd556509626927a387ed6ddb0a4150
